templates.imageHint: Wallpaper artwork is composed inside a fixed 1024 x 1024 square texture guide. PNG or JPG/JPEG supported. The texture repeats across room walls in-game.
templates.mappingNote: Room visual wallpaper. Memento Maker composes the supplied artwork into a fixed 1024 x 1024 texture, assigns it as the wall material Albedo with Metallic set to 0, and repeats it across room walls. Wallpaper does not use an ItemModConfig archetype or variant relationship.

templates.imageHint: Final texture: 1024 x 1024. Artwork is mapped to the Small Poster face using the supplied Poster.fbx UV unwrap.
templates.mappingNote: Measured from the supplied Small Poster Poster.fbx UV unwrap: U 0.2717117-0.7286120, V 0.2574115-0.7425885. The custom artwork is applied to the replacement Poster mesh; the supplied Frame.fbx provides the matching frame geometry.
